newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australia appoints Peacock U.S. ambassador.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australia appoints Peacock U.S. ambassador.

text.p: The Australian government confirmed on Friday the appointment of former foreign minister and Liberal opposition leader Andrew Peacock as ambassador to the United States.
"The government attaches very great importance to Australia's relationship with the United States," Prime Minister John Howard said in a statement.
"Our relationship is a vital one that brings immense economic and strategic benefits to both countries and to our region as a whole."
Peacock will replace John McCarthy, when he takes up an appointment as ambassador to Indonesia early next year.
Peacock served as foreign minister from 1975 to 1980 and was Australian opposition leader from 1983 to 1985 and again in 1989 to 1990.
"I am confident that he will make a large contribution to strengthening our relationship with the United States," Howard said.
